title: Going With the Tenderness
style: Soft rock with a disco drive, mid-tempo four-on-the-floor groove, rounded melodic bass, crisp live kit with open hi-hat, clean electric piano and bright restrained guitar, subtle string accents in the chorus. Narrative male lead vocal, conversational and intimate in the verses, opening into a warm memorable chorus. Arrangement builds from a lean verse to a wider chorus, with a brief instrumental lift before the final verse; polished organic studio mix, bittersweet romantic tension.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I thought about seeing Gabi again
More than I meant to, less than I said
Since my wife, I kept the edges neat
Short-lived stories, no promises to keep
One night, one tour, a season at most
Safe in the joke, safe in the toast
Even with Erika, friendship made room
For touch without asking what came soon

[Pre-Chorus]
Then Claire came back through Dallas skies
We kept our distance, kept our ties
Jersey for her, Manhattan for me
A seatmate’s laugh, and Claire saw me

[Chorus]
I was trying to keep it uncomplicated
Keep every door from opening wide
But your hand in mine felt almost like home
And I couldn’t make that feeling lie
I was careful till the careful gave way
One tired evening, one kiss, one yes
Now the morning’s carrying us away
And I’m going with the tenderness

[Verse 2]
I knew Gabi might undo my plans
Claire was already changing where I stand
A week in the City, work by day
Then finding Gabi when the streets made space
Her studio, Susan, Michael, José
Susan smiled; I looked away
No late nights, no room to stay
Just arms around us at the end of the day

[Pre-Chorus]
It felt too gentle, too close to home
Not the bright escape I thought I’d known
Then the night before Bogotá
She came by early; the evening turned

[Chorus]
I was trying to keep it uncomplicated
Keep every door from opening wide
But your hand in mine felt almost like home
And I couldn’t make that feeling lie
I was careful till the careful gave way
One tired evening, one kiss, one yes
Now the morning’s carrying us away
And I’m going with the tenderness

[Bridge]
I thought I was too worn to want you
Till wanting rose up clear and strong
“Come with me to Bogotá this weekend”
You said yes before the doubt came on

[Final Chorus]
I was trying to keep it uncomplicated
But the truth had already crossed the line
Your passport waiting back in your apartment
My ride to Teterboro right on time
I was careful till the careful gave way
One tired evening, one kiss, one yes
Now the morning’s carrying us away
And I’m going with the tenderness

[Outro]
Back to Manhattan, bags by the door
A weekend ahead, and no plan anymore
